runtime_failure.root_cause: Not established without device capture. Static evidence establishes diagnostics gaps, not the active failing device gate.
confirmed_gaps: Early failed bindings are discarded without samples.

options.semantics: Classic keeps the existing trusted community ranking. Casual also evaluates title-matched community category votes; selected category thresholds can retain an original. Add funny, creative, clever, descriptive and other categories. Do not guess casual classification from title wording.
options.implementation: Extend immutable backend metadata/result with bounded casualVotes; compare against the owned original title; refresh title and thumbnail independently.

options.semantics: Keep the existing independent switch and per-screen overrides.
options.implementation: Policy result gates all title transformations, including original-title formatting; changing it restores/reloads matching native rows.

options.semantics: Keep the independent thumbnail switch and screen policy.
options.implementation: Image state must distinguish community, generated fallback, native original, and explicit blank; native image decode/cache and lease stay scoped.

options.semantics: A separate switch chooses whether a community title may supply text. Original-title formatting can still operate when this is disabled.
options.implementation: Do not request title-only branding when no selection-dependent option needs it. Choose the original source, then run the formatter.

options.semantics: Keep a per-video session choice separate from the preference. Prefetch decisions but initially present the leased original when enabled.
options.implementation: Use a native card context-menu action and a watch-page menu action to reveal community details. Do not require mouse hover or add a floating player box.

options.option: Title format: Disabled / Title Case / Sentence Case / Lower Case / First Letter Uppercase / Capitalize Words
options.semantics: Define explicit stable string enums: disabled, title_case, sentence_case, lower_case, first_letter_uppercase, capitalize_words. Preserve original wording before every application.
options.implementation: Create RVDeArrowFormatting.inc with Unicode-aware word/sentence handling, abbreviation and acronym rules, bounded text, and original/custom provenance. A generic capitalizedString alone is not title-case parity.

options.semantics: Apply the selected case policy to the actual original title when no usable community title is selected, or crowdsourced titles are disabled.
options.implementation: This is the primary difference from 0.3.34: absence of submissions must not prevent local formatting. Show-original restores the unformatted lease.

options.semantics: Gate case conversion independently for community titles.
options.implementation: Emoji cleanup is a separate policy; disabling case conversion must not silently disable it. Never format already formatted text again.

options.semantics: Process composed Unicode sequences and upstream letter-like emoji substitutions; preserve useful letters, numbers and mathematical symbols.
options.implementation: Handle ZWJ, variation selectors, modifiers and keycaps as sequences. Emoji cleanup and fancy-letter normalization precede case conversion; record only lengths and hashes.

options.semantics: Use source-language recognition on the original title, not interface language. Low-confidence detection retains original case when non-English conversion is disabled.
options.implementation: Add NaturalLanguage framework and confidence-aware language detection. Protect proper nouns, acronyms, Turkish casing and Greek-letter behavior; do not claim browser-language-model equivalence.

options.option: Fallback: Screenshot from a random time
options.semantics: Use a validated per-video duration and stable chosen timestamp, preferably the branding randomTime fraction. Avoid promotional SponsorBlock intervals for that video.
options.implementation: Extend backend metadata with videoDuration/randomTime; add a bounded per-video duration and segment cache. Never use the currently playing duration/segments for a different feed video. Send explicit time to the image service and verify timestamp/decode.

options.semantics: This remains the migration default. A trusted community-original decision also retains the native source.
options.implementation: Separate deliberate original from missing metadata, service error, role rejection and decoded-image failure in reports.

options.semantics: Blank is an intentional presentation state, not a network failure or collapsed row.
options.implementation: Supply a scoped opaque placeholder image with original aspect ratio and preserve duration overlays, accessibility, taps and cell size; restore native source when disabled/reused.

options.semantics: Expose start/middle/end generated variants with full-image validation. Existing stills maps to this policy during migration.
options.implementation: Resolve hq1/hq2/hq3 for the bound video; reject unavailable/placeholder images, retain original on failure. Replace cached-only probing with an asynchronous decoded result and guarded refresh.

options.semantics: Require an explicit upcoming/live metadata contract and owning channel ID; this is not inferred from a title label.
options.implementation: Use a validated avatar from that channel to compose a cover image with native aspect ratio. Keep avatar replacement scoped to the thumbnail role; do not alter native channel avatars globally.

options.semantics: Normalize a verified native original _custom_N URL variant to its stable original source for that same video.
options.implementation: Store both the received native variant and the normalized presentation source. Validate the normalized image and fall back to the received source on errors; preserve proxy query semantics and unaffected URLs.

options.semantics: Only the owned title/thumbnail roles enter a pending placeholder state; loading a feed row must never hide channel data, controls or the whole card.
options.implementation: Use a bounded deadline and restore originals on timeout, missing/untrusted/original decisions, disabled policy, owner change or reuse. Screen readers need a temporary loading label and native restoration. This requires a proven role and native layout contract.

options.option: Do not show translated YouTube titles
options.semantics: Prefer verified originalTitle fields in the same owned video model when no community title is available.
options.implementation: ELMPBMetadata.originalTitle30 is already known for some templates. Add explicit entity/legacy source-language title evidence before enabling other routes; no global translation disabling or generic text heuristics.

options.semantics: Bound the preference to 1..6 and apply to ordinary feed suggestions, with watch title handled separately according to its native layout.
options.implementation: Use Metadata.maxTitleLine7 on the isolated copy where the template reads it; identify lockup/watch text constraints before changing them. Recompute native row sizing and preserve accessibility/RTL/truncation.

options.semantics: Clamp 0..100; 100 retains native colors. Treat this as a presentation transform after image selection.
options.implementation: Use CoreImage color controls on decoded images off main, with cache keys including source, timestamp and effect revision. For originals use an owned source/result, not a global UIImage hook; keep original leases unfiltered.

options.semantics: Requires a DeArrow submission/vote interface and candidate UUIDs. It is not an existing SponsorBlock vote or a cache-retention switch.
options.implementation: Extend backend results with candidate identity; persist bounded per-video local selections separately from downloaded rankings, prune by age/count, and invalidate by settings revision. Do not send any vote automatically.

options.semantics: Provide a native watch menu row and card context-menu entry consistently, including when no branding changed.
options.implementation: The action uses the existing original/community lease. Inline controls require a verified native title/action slot; maintain native spacing and navigation gestures, and never overlay the video player.

options.semantics: On touch use explicit tap-toggle/context-menu preview; optional pointer hover may be added on pointer-equipped iPads.
options.implementation: Temporary peek restores the previous presentation state on release/dismissal and respects reuse/settings revisions. It must not steal the native long-press video preview, swipe-back, or scrolling gestures.

options.semantics: Track formatted-original separately from community title provenance.
options.implementation: Expose the original action when local formatting changed visible text according to this setting; returning original bypasses both case and emoji cleanup.

options.semantics: Add a native help row and guidance in the future contribution screen.
options.implementation: Link the official guidelines and provide short local explanations. Keep configuration help independent of service and presentation readiness.

options.semantics: The browser options-page preference becomes Use app theme / Light / Dark for a native settings controller if needed.
options.implementation: Reuse the existing settings/theme infrastructure; do not force a global appearance change or duplicate a web-style options page.

pipeline: metadata, casual votes, optional local selections
guarded native materialization and layout refresh

phases.name: Capture actual failing native route
phases.deliverable: 0.3.35 diagnostics, settings capture/probe/copy actions, pinned native evidence, one unsigned Xcode IPA. No option-parity claims or guessed template expansion.

phases.name: Repair the captured first blocking native gate
phases.deliverable: Use owner/union/template/model/ABI observations to corroborate a typed route in the original binary. Add a pinned contract, then connect factory ownership and refresh; unknown roots remain originals.

phases.name: Selection and formatting
phases.deliverable: Versioned policy, six case modes, crowdsourced toggle, separate original/custom formatting, Unicode cleanup, language gate, default-original state and original actions.

phases.name: Fallback images and metadata
phases.deliverable: Original/blank/YouTube frame/random screenshot, per-video duration/SponsorBlock intervals, upcoming cover, stable native thumbnail and anti-translated title where evidence exists.

phases.name: Presentation controls
phases.deliverable: Native title-line constraints, scoped saturation, pending placeholders with restore deadlines, context-menu/tap/pointer original preview; no floating player controls.

phases.name: Casual decisions and contributions
phases.deliverable: Category votes bound to the original title, threshold selection, candidate UUIDs, explicit voting/submission UI and persisted local selections; contextual guidelines and app theme.

precedence: Known owner and video identity are mandatory regardless of mode.
Disabled part or explicit Show Original returns the untouched original lease.
Explicit community reveal overrides default-original and temporary Casual choice; screen original policies still disable their part.
Do not override a trusted community-original thumbnail with random/blank fallback.
Format from pristine original/community text exactly once, never the displayed title.
A service/image error is separate from intentional blank, missing submissions and original selection.

migration.existing_keys: Keep dearrow_titles, dearrow_thumbnails, endpoint keys and per-screen policies. Schema bump supplies safe defaults without losing saved settings.
migration.fallback: original stays original; legacy stills maps to youtube_frame; random_time and blank require explicit settings choices.
migration.defaults: Do not silently convert every existing feed to browser defaults while diagnosing a failed adapter. Enable new formatting/fallback behavior only when its effective policy is defined and shown.
migration.native_ui: Use the shared native settings catalog/row model; create Mode, Titles, Thumbnails, Display, Original/Community, Service/Diagnostics sections without a parallel HTML page.

backend_extensions: bounded casualVotes with title match and category counts
fallback result/source enum distinct from community vote decisions
cancelled/coalesced per-video ancillary metadata and segment lookups
decoded-image effect cache key separate from service cache

native_evidence.short_factory: ELMCellNode.nodeBlockForEntry:responder:0x100461bd4 delegates to full factory; YTElementsCellController.cellNodeBlock0x104242828 uses that route without itself establishing section TLS.
native_evidence.data_consumption: YTIElementRenderer.elementData0x10050da14 reads/caches the native bytes extension. FUN10050d94c calls that getter before element decode; the RenderNext builder also uses it. New capture counts copied-byte consumption.
native_evidence.initialization: initWithElementData:0x1043197b0 stores the native extension; initWithElement:0x104319848 obtains serialized data first.
native_evidence.row_lease: Original array entry, cached controller, controller entry, owner/video, serialized source and revisions are checked individually; the report names the failed contract.
